💡 Writing is thinking.

A clearer sentence can reveal an unclear idea. 🪔 diyalamp helps you examine what you mean, what supports it, and what would change your mind.

Inspired by Paul Graham’s Good Writing. Clear prose helps you inspect your reasoning. It does not establish that your premises are true.

💬 Your argument. Your call.

Separate observations from assumptions. Consider the strongest objection. Revise the claim when the evidence calls for it.

With 🪔 diyalamp, the AI suggests. You provide context and approve changes. A review helps you reason; it does not certify a decision.
